# APEX BANK

> APEX BANK is an online banking simulation offering account opening, multi-currency accounts (AZN, USD, EUR), debit and credit cards, internal transfers, transaction history, notifications, and an AI assistant.

APEX BANK lets customers open an account online in about two minutes with no branch visit. Accounts, cards, transfers and support are available in Azerbaijani, English and Russian, 24/7.
